lessons.title: 14. Window Functions
lessons.description: Calculate employee salary rank within each department using `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC)`.
lessons.starter_code: SELECT first_name, department, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rank FROM employees;
